title: Works street planting
caption: Fuller foliage and tree shadows along the Works street south of the recycling centre, with connected low planting and three beds beside the west fence. Original views and every attempt are included. The rest of Works remains in progress.

sections.title: Original planting: first route
sections.caption: Original public-mode Works views with the ordinary player camera. Captures include the route and matching performance positions.

sections.title: Original planting: phone return route
sections.caption: Original public-mode Works views with the ordinary player camera. Captures include the route and matching performance positions.

sections.title: Original planting: matched performance views
sections.caption: Original public-mode Works views with the ordinary player camera. Captures include the route and matching performance positions.

sections.title: Attempt 1: asset setup failed
sections.caption: Rejected setup attempt: the worktree lacked a locked public asset and did not boot. This failure frame is retained.

sections.title: Attempt 2: bare mulch and separate mounds
sections.caption: Rejected: exposed mulch and separated shrub mounds. Normal walking routes completed at both sizes.

sections.title: Attempt 3: overly even ground detail
sections.caption: Rejected: ground detail was too even and tree crowns remained angular. Matched performance views are included.

sections.title: Attempt 4: smooth crowns
sections.caption: Rejected: the smoother crown envelopes looked like solid cushions. Includes morning and evening routes.

sections.title: Attempt 5: sparse pointed leaves
sections.caption: Rejected: sparse pointed leaves decorated broad bare crown faces.

sections.title: Attempt 6: tree shadows restored, foliage still sparse
sections.caption: Rejected: real tree shadows restored grounding, but broad crown faces and sparse low planting remained.

sections.title: Attempt 7: overlapping broad foliage
sections.caption: Rejected: tree and west shrub surfaces improved, but the east underplant still exposed plain polygon masses.

sections.title: Attempt 8: east shrub foliage
sections.caption: East shrubs receive the same broad foliage surfaces. These are the first representative views, before the full final route checks.

sections.title: Final route: morning, return and evening
sections.caption: The reviewed planting on current main, with the ordinary player camera at both sizes. The street remains clear; evening images retain the existing lighting.

sections.title: Matched checks: current main baseline
sections.caption: Same ordinary camera, quality and positions for the default Works arrival and three street points. These are measurement captures; the arrival area is outside the planting changes.

sections.title: Matched checks: final planting
sections.caption: Same ordinary camera, quality and positions for the default Works arrival and three street points. These are measurement captures; the arrival area is outside the planting changes.
